scripts.build: npm run make:static && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: npm run make:cards && vite build && node scripts/make-frame-symbols.mjs build
scripts.build:client:desktop: npm run make:cards && vite build --mode desktop && node scripts/make-frame-symbols.mjs build-desktop
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['build', 'build-desktop', 'src/genfiles']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:i18n && npm run lint:client && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p src/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.make:cards: npx tsx src/server/tools/export_card_rendering.ts && npx tsx src/tools/make_card_art_manifest.ts && node scripts/make-card-art-thumbs.mjs
scripts.make:static: npm run make:css && npm run make:json
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:client: cross-env NODE_ENV=development node scripts/run-tests.mjs --label client --min 9500 -- node scripts/client-tests.mts "tests/client/**/*.spec.ts"
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run build:test && playwright test tests/e2e --workers=1 --reporter=list,html --trace=retain-on-failure
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build:main && npm run build:diagnostics && cross-env TM_SERVER_BASE=http://localhost:5173 electron build/electron/main.js
scripts.build:desktop: npm run make:static && npm run build:client:desktop && node scripts/build-node.mts desktop && node scripts/check-embedded-bundle.mjs
scripts.electron:desktop: npm run build:desktop && cross-env TM_ELECTRON_LOAD=app electron build/electron/main.js
scripts.electron:pack:dir: npm run build:desktop && node -e "for (const d of ['dist-desktop']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})" && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:dir:win: npm run build:desktop && node -e "for (const d of ['dist-desktop']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})" && electron-builder --dir --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:dir:linux: npm run build:desktop && node -e "for (const d of ['dist-desktop']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})" && electron-builder --dir --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:only:win: node -e "for (const d of ['dist-desktop']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})" && electron-builder --dir --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.pack:only:linux: node -e "for (const d of ['dist-desktop']) require('fs').rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})" && electron-builder --dir --linux --config electron-builder.yml
